title: Venezuelan Lentil Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bowl filled with lentils, spices, and a kick of heat. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: Venezuelan Salsa
ingredients.notes: available at most grocery stores or make your own

instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the lentils, cumin, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
While the lentils are cooking, heat the Venezuelan Salsa in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped red onion and cook until softened.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked lentils between two bowls.
Top with the salsa mixture and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
